title: Checkout accumulator initialised as None

provenance.upstream_commit: Fixed #37075 -- Allowed overriding the PostgreSQL pool's "check" callable.
provenance.modeled_on: an accumulator/option left as None reaches an operation expecting a value

mutations.find:
items = CARTS.pop(cart_id)

mutations.replace:
items = CARTS.pop(cart_id)
    if not items:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="cart is empty")

notes: stateful: needs a populated cart to reach the accumulation
